name: areSendingDomainsAuthenticated
definition: True when the email service has at least one authenticated sending domain and every authenticated domain has a valid record, so mail from those domains aligns with DKIM and SPF. A stale invalid duplicate beside a valid record for the same domain is a finding, not a failure.
population: the authenticated sending domains in one email-service account; denominator = every domain the read lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the account's domain authentication records showing every domain valid; a cut-off, error, 401/403 or unrecognised read is Not evaluated. An empty list is a real read of no authenticated domain and is False.
citations: SendGrid API reference, Domain Authentication (twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/domain-authentication): GET /v3/whitelabel/domains returns valid and the dns records per domain

changeLog.change: Registered so the SendGrid email-security transformations can emit it. Meaning written from the public SendGrid API reference and one read of a real account (read-only); no replay-backed validation yet, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Judges the service's own report that the DNS records resolve (valid), not a separate DNS lookup. A domain that sends through another provider is out of scope. Messaging Security is allowed too because the SendGrid integration is catalogued under communication (Messaging Security).
